privacy_rule: Only safe structure, dates and organization-level content are recorded. Person-level rows in live HR trackers remain restricted.

artifacts.title: FMLA Tracker
artifacts.evidence_kind: restricted case tracker with Active 2026 tab and annual history back to 2009
artifacts.implication: FMLA had a dedicated operational tracker in 2026; old email reminders were not the only case-management mechanism.
artifacts.authority_caution: Tracker rows/notes are case evidence, not policy authority.

artifacts.title: Attendance Tracker
artifacts.evidence_kind: restricted derived tracker with INPUT/Attendance/Previous Months/Points tracker/Blacklist tabs
artifacts.implication: 2026 attendance workflow imported an ADP Employee Daily Totals Report and derived reserve/FMLA/points fields.
artifacts.authority_caution: Spreadsheet logic must be validated against the 2025 handbook and current business rules.

artifacts.title: RTEC Plan Cost Comparison
artifacts.implication: Current HR/benefits work included plan-cost/design comparison for the 2026-27 cycle.
artifacts.authority_caution: Planning workbook is not itself a final plan document or approved employee communication.

artifacts.title: Medicare Plan G vs Employer Health Plan comparison/template
artifacts.implication: Medicare-versus-employer-plan analysis was actively explored in 2026.
artifacts.authority_caution: One comparison references University of Kentucky plan context, so it must not be treated as RTEC-specific policy. The separate RTEC Plan Cost Comparison is the stronger RTEC-specific source.

artifacts.title: RTEC County Openings
artifacts.implication: Recruiting/open-position planning is currently tracked by service county, providing a present-day operational successor/context to older county job-order workflows.
artifacts.authority_caution: Blank opening cells are not interpreted as zero; the sheet is planning evidence, not an ATS replacement.

artifacts.title: Kentucky EEO certification approval
artifacts.implication: Annual Kentucky EEO certification/recertification remains a current compliance cycle distinct from the AAP plan cycle.
artifacts.authority_caution: The approval proves current certification through expiration, not that renewal after 2026-09-30 has been completed.

separation_rules: Current artifact existence proves a workflow/tool existed recently, not that every field/rule remains authoritative today.
Reference/personal comparison sheets must not be promoted to RTEC policy merely because they reside in the same Drive.
Restricted case trackers contribute safe schemas/process evidence only.
Current organization-level approvals and signed policies outrank old email reminders for currentness.
